en: Burn
zh_CN: 燃烧

en: Takes fire damage each second equal to burn stacks then loses 1 burn. Ends at 0 burn.
zh_CN: 每 1 秒按燃烧层数造成火焰伤害并消耗 1 层，燃烧归零时结束。

en: Lightning Staff
zh_CN: 闪电法杖

en: Hitting a charged enemy discharges and branches to nearby enemies, applying Arc.
zh_CN: 闪电弹珠命中带电敌人引发放电时，向附近敌人传导并施加电弧。

en: Arc
zh_CN: 电弧

en: A 5-second stacking charge; hitting a charged enemy discharges all stored stacks.
zh_CN: 持续 5 秒、可叠加的电荷；命中带电敌人放电时释放全部层数。

en: Echo
zh_CN: 回响

en: Enemy hits charge the flippers; launching with charge triggers a Power Strike; multi-layer charge launches give a bigger bonus.
zh_CN: 命中敌人为挡板蓄力；带蓄力弹起触发强力击；多层蓄力发射获得更大加成。

en: Power Strike
zh_CN: 强力击

en: A flipper launch that consumes charge: boosts marble speed and arms Echo bonus damage on the next enemy hit.
zh_CN: 挡板带蓄力弹起弹珠时触发：提升球速，下次命中附加回响伤害。

en: Pierce
zh_CN: 穿透

en: While piercing, the marble passes through enemies instead of bouncing off. Each enemy passed takes a full hit; pierce hits benefit from Power Strike exactly like normal hits.
zh_CN: 穿透期间弹珠穿过敌人而非弹开，每穿过一名敌人造成一次完整命中；穿透伤害与普通命中一样享受强力击加成。

en: Poison
zh_CN: 中毒

en: Each layer deals 1 poison damage per second for 5 seconds. Applying it again refreshes the 5-second timer.
zh_CN: 每层每秒造成 1 点毒素伤害，持续 5 秒，再次施加会刷新持续时长。

en: Infection
zh_CN: 感染

en: Triggers at 10 poison stacks. Permanently marks the target without direct damage until it dies.
zh_CN: 目标中毒达到 10 层时触发；永久标记目标且不直接造成伤害，直至目标死亡。

en: Plague
zh_CN: 瘟疫

en: When an infected enemy dies it immediately releases 1 fly.
zh_CN: 带感染标记的敌人死亡时触发；立即释放 1 只苍蝇。

en: Fly
zh_CN: 苍蝇

en: Created by an infected enemy's death. Lasts 5 seconds and bites the nearest enemy every 0.5 seconds for 1 poison damage.
zh_CN: 由感染敌人死亡生成；存在 5 秒，接近最近敌人后每 0.5 秒叮咬 1 次，每次造成 1 点毒素伤害。

en: Frost
zh_CN: 冰霜

en: Ice-marble hits add stacks that last 2 seconds. At 6 stacks they immediately become Frozen for 4 seconds.
zh_CN: 冰霜弹珠命中时叠 1 层；层数保留 2 秒，达到 6 层时立即转为持续 4 秒的冻结状态。

en: Frozen
zh_CN: 冻结

en: At 6 frost stacks the target becomes a pushable ice block. Each collision costs it 1 HP for 4 seconds.
zh_CN: 冰霜达到 6 层时触发；目标成为可推动冰块并在每次碰撞损失 1 生命，持续 4 秒。

en: Weak Point
zh_CN: 破绽

en: The enemy shows a random cardinal marker. Hit from that direction to crit then the marker changes direction.
zh_CN: 敌人出现随机四方向标记；从标记方向命中则暴击，命中后标记更换方向。

en: Crit
zh_CN: 暴击

en: This hit deals x2 damage. Triggered by weak points and other effects.
zh_CN: 本次伤害 ×2；由破绽等多种效果触发。

en: Perfect Crit
zh_CN: 完美暴击

en: Triggered by precisely striking a weak point. This hit deals x2.25 damage.
zh_CN: 精确命中破绽时；本次伤害 ×2.25。

en: Detonate
zh_CN: 引爆

en: Consumes Bombs to trigger an Explosion when a Bomb Marble collides with an enemy; it cannot trigger at 0 Bombs.
zh_CN: 炸弹弹珠碰撞敌人时消耗炸弹数并触发爆炸；炸弹数为 0 时无法引爆。

en: Explosion
zh_CN: 爆炸

en: A bomb marble collision deals 4 explosion damage to targets within radius 75 immediately.
zh_CN: 炸弹弹珠碰撞敌人时触发；立即对半径 75 内目标造成 4 点爆炸伤害。
